title: Jefferson Ortiz — Data & software
description: Applications, data analysis and projects by Jefferson Ortiz. What they do, how they are built, and what is still in progress.
intro: An app to tailor a CV, another to track expenses, a map of live trains. Take a look at the projects I build, how they work and the decisions behind them.
browse: Take a look at the projects
empty: There are no projects in this category.
about_paragraphs: I build applications that connect data, APIs and interfaces. This collection ranges from small tools to applications with background processing.
Alongside what I have built, I want to share the choices behind it and the parts I have yet to figure out.

work_notes.heading: Code that leaves room for change
work_notes.body: I separate responsibilities when they change for different reasons. An abstraction needs to solve a problem that is already there.

work_notes.heading: Keeping track of decisions
work_notes.body: I write down what I try, why I choose an approach and what remains unfinished. That includes the things that do not go as planned.
